basic_details.short_information: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a Government of India Undertaking, has one post of Advisor – Electrical on contract basis under Advertisement No. 01112026. The post is open only to ex-employees of RCF who retired as Chief Manager or above. Applications go only by email to [email protected] and must be received by 16 November 2026 at 17.00 hours.

Where company quarters are not available at the place of posting but bachelor guest house accommodation is, the guest house will be provided free of charge. Facilities such as medical, TA/DA, Sports Club etc. are given as applicable to the Advisor's last regular employment in RCF. The Advisor will not be eligible for other benefits like PF, Gratuity, Earned Leave, Medical Leave, PRP etc. GST, if applicable, will be paid by RCF under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), and RCF will avail the Input Tax Credit. | The appointment shall be for a period of six months. The appointment can be terminated by giving one month's notice from either side. The appointment will not establish a relationship of employer and employee in any way.

Any corrigendum, addendum or errata will be displayed only on www.rcfltd.com under the head "HR-RECRUITMENT". Canvassing in any form at any stage is a disqualification. Retired as Chief Manager or above from RCF, with at least 10 years' Electrical maintenance and operations experience in RCF

content_sections.heading: About RCF
content_sections.text: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd) is a Government of India Undertaking with its Administrative Building at Chembur, Mumbai. It manufactures and markets Fertilizers and Industrial Chemicals, reports revenues from operation of around Rs. 18690.90 Crores and was given "Navratna" status in August 2023. Its manufacturing units are in Maharashtra at Thal (Dist. Raigad) and at Trombay (Chembur, Mumbai), with a national marketing network.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent by email only to [email protected] . The subject of the email should be: "Post applied for - Advisor – Electrical on contract basis". The notice says applications sent to any other e-mail id will be rejected and a physical form of application will not be accepted. Candidates should have a valid email ID. It cannot be changed after the application is submitted, and all communication about the selection process will be sent to that email address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single post is Advisor – Electrical on contract basis (1 post), advertised for ex-employees of RCF. The eligibility criteria are counted as on 01.11.2026, which the notice names as the cut-off date for determining eligibility. Retirement grade: The applicant should have retired from the post of Chief Manager or above from RCF. Experience: Hands on experience in Maintenance and operations in Electrical department within RCF for not less than 10 years. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Age: The applicant's age shall be below 65 years while applying. A superannuated employee shall be engaged as an Advisor maximum up to the age of 65 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post. An Advisor staying in RCF Township may retain the Township accommodation for a maximum of one month from the last day of the contract and will be charged ALF, water charges and electricity charges etc. as per company rules. In that case the remuneration is 70% of last drawn Basic + DA. Where company quarters are not available at the place of posting but bachelor guest house accommodation is, the guest house will be provided free of charge. Tax on township accommodation and other perquisites, if any, is borne by the Advisor. The payment is subject to TDS. Casual leave accrues at 1 day per month; the Advisor is also eligible for RCF Holidays. Facilities such as medical, TA/DA, Sports Club etc. are given as applicable to the Advisor's last regular employment in RCF. The Advisor will not be eligible for other benefits like PF, Gratuity, Earned Leave, Medical Leave, PRP etc. GST, if applicable, will be paid by RCF under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM), and RCF will avail the Input Tax Credit. The appointment shall be for a period of six months. The appointment can be terminated by giving one month's notice from either side. The appointment will not establish a relationship of employer and employee in any way.

content_sections.heading: RCF Advisor – Electrical Job Description
content_sections.text: The Advisor – Electrical on contract basis performs the jobs described in the roles and responsibilities, which include, but are not limited to: Daily follow up of all ongoing activities. Regular review of progress, briefing to RCF Management. Pinpointing the limitations/issues, shortfalls. Expert advice for overcoming the limitations. Plan of action for addressing the concerns. Any other job entrusted.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the Annexure – I format Scanned copies of documents in support of age and date of birth Scanned copies of documents in support of work experience Service certificate issued by RCF at the time of superannuation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the RCF Advisor – Electrical post is through a Personal Interview. Candidates who fulfil the minimum criteria will be shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates who are prima facie eligible, based on their application form, will be informed through electronic mode. The interview may be conducted through Personal Interview, Video Conferencing or Online Mode. To qualify, candidates need a minimum average of 50% marks in the interview. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not by itself entitle a candidate to take part in the selection process, and RCF Ltd's decision on eligibility and shortlisting is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RCF Advisor – Electrical Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Advisor – Electrical on contract basis under Advertisement No. 01112026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RCF Advisor – Electrical post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by email by 16 November 2026 at 17.00 hours.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the RCF Advisor – Electrical post?
faq.answer: Ex-employees who retired from the post of Chief Manager or above from RCF, with hands on experience in Maintenance and operations in the Electrical department within RCF for not less than 10 years, as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the RCF Advisor – Electrical post?
faq.answer: The applicant's age must be below 65 years while applying, and a superannuated employee can be engaged as Advisor maximum up to the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the RCF Advisor – Electrical?
faq.answer: The pay is a lump sum remuneration of 80% of last drawn Basic Pay + DA, or 70% of last drawn Basic + DA when the Advisor retains RCF Township accommodation.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the RCF Advisor – Electrical post?
faq.answer: Email the filled Annexure – I application form with scanned supporting documents to [email protected]; physical applications and applications to any other email id are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject?
faq.answer: The subject should be "Post applied for - Advisor – Electrical on contract basis".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the RCF Advisor – Electrical post?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Personal Interview of 100 marks, which may be held in person, by video conferencing or online, and candidates need a minimum average of 50% marks to qualify.

faq.question: Q9. Is the RCF Advisor – Electrical post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract appointment for six months, which can be ended by one month's notice from either side and does not create an employer-employee relationship.

faq.question: Q10. Are allowances or other benefits paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: The Advisor gets facilities such as medical, TA/DA and Sports Club as applicable to the last regular RCF employment, casual leave at 1 day per month and RCF Holidays, but not PF, Gratuity, Earned Leave, Medical Leave or PRP.
